STRONG_BUY.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; the locked score T from analysis_brief is at least +8; none of the four core drivers R, O, H, and F is negative; and both forward drivers H and F are positive.

MEDIUM_BUY.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; STRONG_BUY is not met; T is at least +5; at least two of the four core drivers R, O, H, and F are positive; and at least one forward driver H or F is positive.

WEAK_BUY.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; neither stronger BUY tier is met; T is at least +2; at least one core driver is positive; and either H or F is positive or both current-result drivers R and O equal +2.

HOLD.condition: A hard HOLD or extreme core conflict defined in analysis_brief applies; T is between -1 and +1 inclusive; current and forward core drivers materially oppose each other without meeting a directional condition; or none of the six directional outcome conditions is met. An ordinary habitual company-guide beat with only pass-through or neutral forward revisions is HOLD.

WEAK_SELL.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; neither stronger SELL tier is met; T is at most -2; at least one core driver is negative; and either H or F is negative or both current-result drivers R and O are negative.

MEDIUM_SELL.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; STRONG_SELL is not met; T is at most -5; at least two of the four core drivers R, O, H, and F are negative; and at least one forward driver H or F is negative.

STRONG_SELL.condition: No hard HOLD or extreme core conflict applies; the locked score T from analysis_brief is at most -8; none of the four core drivers R, O, H, and F is positive; and both forward drivers H and F are negative.
